title: Backend Projection Patch v1
description: Incremental projection patch sent from backend to frontend. Unlike the full desktop_projection snapshot, a patch carries only changed sections with their new projection_sequence. Content-light: no raw paths, secrets, prompts, or private file contents.

projection_sequence.description: Monotonic sequence number. Frontend must discard patches with sequence <= last rendered.

trace_id.description: Correlates to the intent or lifecycle event that triggered this patch.

backend_session_id.description: Backend session that produced this patch.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of patch generation.

patch_kind.description: full = complete projection snapshot, partial = named sections replaced, delta = field-level changes.

changed_sections.description: Names of projection sections included in this patch.

sections.description: Section data keyed by section name. Each value is content-light.

digest.description: SHA256 digest of the deterministic canonical JSON of the sections payload.

redaction_status.description: Hard invariant: every projection patch is content_light.

stale_after_seconds.description: If set, frontend should request a fresh full projection after this many seconds.
